'''Scott Boehler''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 North American Continental Championship]] on 11 August 2000 with EBO, according to Yannick Lapointe's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1134">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-16-gencon-2k-who-s-your-daddyd1134/ gencon-2k-who-s-your-daddy], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 16 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-16-gencon-2k-who-s-your-daddyd1134/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
